name: Deathmatch
effectTemplate: If there are at least 2 opponents nearby, ATK is increased by <color=#99FFFFFF>{0}</color> and DEF is increased by <color=#99FFFFFF>{1}</color>. If there are fewer than 2 opponents nearby, ATK is increased by <color=#99FFFFFF>{2}</color>.

r1.description: If there are at least 2 opponents nearby, ATK is increased by 16% and DEF is increased by 16%. If there are fewer than 2 opponents nearby, ATK is increased by 24%.
